title: Fix Tumbler Engraving Jitter & Missing Areas
body_html:
Incomplete Engraving & Edge Jitter on Tumblers - VertiGO Series

This guide explains how to diagnose and resolve edge jitter, inconsistent engraving quality, and missing sections when engraving tumblers, cups, or other cylindrical objects. These issues are typically caused by incorrect scanning offset settings or loose optical components that affect laser beam stability.

Problem Description

When engraving tumblers or cups, regardless of whether the cup is placed opening-up or opening-down, the engraved pattern exhibits noticeable jitter along the edges, and certain sections of the design fail to engrave entirely.

Cause

  • The backlash parameters have either not been uploaded to the controller or contain inaccuracies.
  • Components along the optical path are loose, causing the laser beam to vibrate or drift during high-speed engraving.

Solution

Method 1. Calibrate Scanning Offset Parameters

The process for tuning scanning offsets is universal across our systems. Please follow the step-by-step diagnostic guide found in this article: How to Adjust the Backlash Parameters

Method 2. Inspect the Optical Path Mirrors and Lenses

The laser beam originates from the RF tube and travels through a series of optics.

  • You must inspect the 1st Mirror, 2nd Mirror and 3rd Mirror for any looseness.
  • Check the two black screws securing the focus lens carriage assembly and ensure they are tightly fastened.

 

Important Reminder:

If these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on ZOHO: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket. A technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
